digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output and retry management
propositions: Manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured must be replaced with a single bounded Pydantic Agent operation preserving full request history and using one shared request budget

Wire-context projection via HistoryProcessor must include failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when the full request plus output reserve provably fits within model context window, otherwise omitting entire response while retaining it in all_messages()
Authoritative input overflow (exceeding context window without any output attempt) must raise ContextWindowExceededError without content shortening

Truncation signals (length or max_tokens finish reasons) must trigger exactly one concision-aware ModelRetry instruction within the shared output-retry allowance, distinct from terminal refusal/content-filter cases
Combined request budget must be computed once as base allowance plus configured output-retry allowance with no per-attempt reset, ensuring output-retry counter never trips before request limit

NativeOutput branch must preserve output_mode selection, bug-895c grammar fallback, and terminal truncation via pai_output.guard_capability() while sharing the bounded operation and wire projection with prompted branch
